title: Stochastic non-metric MDS for noisy high-dimensional data
abstract: arXiv:2611.28985v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multidimensional scaling (MDS) constructs low-dimensional embeddings that approximate pairwise distances in a high-dimensional dataset. MDS exists in several flavors, with metric MDS approximating distances directly and non-metric MDS additionally optimizing for an arbitrary monotonic transformation of the high-dimensional distances. Empirically, metric MDS is known to suffer from the curse of dimensionality. Here we extend prior theoretical results for metric MDS on fully uninformative data to a more general case of finite, high-dimensional data with concentrated distances. We show that the metric MDS embeddings of such datasets stay distributionally close to the data-independent limit case. We then show that non-metric MDS is more robust to high-dimensional noise and can yield informative embeddings of such data. translated_title: 面向噪声高维数据的随机非度量多维标度法
translated_abstract: 多维标度法（MDS）通过构建低维嵌入来逼近高维数据集中的成对距离。MDS存在若干变体，其中度量MDS直接逼近距离，而非度量MDS则额外针对高维距离的任意单调变换进行优化。经验上已知，度量MDS会受到维数灾难的影响。本文将先前关于度量MDS在完全无信息数据上的理论结果，推广到具有集中距离的有限高维数据这一更一般的情形。我们证明此类数据集的度量MDS嵌入在分布上仍接近于与数据无关的极限情形。随后我们证明非度量MDS对高维噪声更为鲁棒，能够为此类数据产生有信息量的嵌入。鉴于现有的非度量MDS实现速度较慢，我们基于随机梯度下降开发了一种快速实现。
tldr: 本文将度量MDS的维数灾难理论推广到距离集中的有限高维数据，证明非度量MDS对高维噪声更鲁棒并能产生有效嵌入，同时提出基于随机梯度下降的快速实现。
en_tdlr: This paper extends the curse-of-dimensionality theory of metric MDS to finite high-dimensional data with concentrated distances, shows that non-metric MDS is more robust to high-dimensional noise and can yield informative embeddings, and develops a fast stochastic-gradient-descent implementation.
